[[Gatekeeper Dedrick]] guards the entrance into the [[Unwaking Waters (Kurzick)]].

==Locations==
*[[The Jade Sea]]
**{{NPC location|Unwaking Waters|explorable area}}

<!--If you have more unspent Kurzick faction than Luxon, or are a member of a Kurzick-allied guild:

:{{ask|gold}} '''We have business in Unwaking Waters.''' (if your character has completed [[Befriending the Kurzicks]])

:{{x}} '''I'll be on my way.'''

If you have more unspent Luxon faction than Kurzick, or are not a member of a Kurzick-allied guild:-->

:{{ask|gold}} '''We have business in Unwaking Waters.''' (if your character has completed [[Befriending the Kurzicks]])

== Notes ==
* His dialogue will refer to your character as being a Luxon even if your character has more unspent Kurzick faction and/or is in a Kurzick [[guild]], which is similar to [[Hylas (Factions)|Hylas]] who refers to every character as being a Kurzick.
